name: Noggle's Lost Satchel
label: Quest
description: Noggle's Lost Satchel: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Where am I? Where's my bag? I must've lost it while fleeing from Deathclasp, the giant scorpid. In my rush to escape I walked right into a nest of stonelash flayers.

The satchel I was carrying had all sorts of rare reagents in it. Without them, me and Beetix won't be able to make the potions that Cenarion Hold needs. I'm too weak to get up yet, but I can make it worth your while if you bring back my reagents.
I ran into Deathclasp in the southern mountain range, behind Bronzebeard's camp.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Still haven't found my bag? Well I should count my lucky stars, at least the poison's been cleansed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes! You brought my satchel back. And my rare reagents are all here! I'll be in your debt for a long time.
